将从这台设备移除 infOS 程序。: Remove the infOS application from this device.
聊天记录、记忆与配置不会随程序一起移除。: Chat history, memories and settings will remain on this device.
本次卸载带有清理数据参数，应用数据将按原卸载流程处理。: This uninstall command requests data cleanup. The existing uninstall process will handle app data.
检测到当前用户和所有用户两份安装，请选择要移除的一份。: Both current-user and all-users installations were found. Choose which one to remove.
infOS 程序已从这台设备移除。: The infOS application has been removed from this device.
个人数据已保留。: Your personal data has been kept.
部分文件仍在安装目录中，请关闭相关程序后检查该目录。: Some files remain in the installation folder. Close related programs and check this folder.
卸载已中止。请查看详情，处理文件占用或权限问题后重试。: Uninstall stopped. Check the details, resolve file access or permission issues, then try again.
部分操作需要重启 Windows 才能完成。可以稍后重启，或保存工作后立即重启。: Restart Windows to complete the remaining operations. Restart later, or save your work and restart now.
程序文件正在移除，请稍等片刻。: Removing application files. Please wait a moment.
一小段等待，留给伸个懒腰。: A little wait is a good moment for a stretch.
窗口可以最小化，卸载会继续进行。: You can minimize this window. Uninstalling will continue.
想了解当前进度，可以展开执行详情。: Open the details to see what is happening.
今天也记得给眼睛放个小假。: Remember to give your eyes a little break today.
喝口水，稍微放松一下。: Have a sip of water and take a moment to relax.
